kb_proposals: Hereditary gluing of a concrete causality, three routes: causal arc-connectedness (Causal.GluingModels.forall_of_causallyArcConnected); a chain of an absolutely minimal neighbour avoiding the bad points (the cut line: timelike chain whose right ends avoid a, the step across a in one member of the cover); subdivision of a segment by exists_subdivision_Icc (spokes, galileo 0).

Refuting gluing: a relation across an open A ⊔ B with disjoint closures never survives the cover {M ∖ cl B, M ∖ cl A} (Causal.GluingModels.le_mem_of_split); hence on a T2.5 space every Causality.ofRelation relating two distinct points, and every relation 'x, y ∈ U and R x y', is not absolutely minimal (not_absolutelyMinimal_of_le_of_ne).

Galileo's spacetime ℝ^{n+1}, n ≥ 1, is not absolutely minimal: an open set with a cup-shaped wall and the cover {t > 1/4, t < 1/2} (Causal.GluingModels.galileoOn_not_minimal); at n = 0 it glues (galileoOn_point_hereditary).
Meta-scripts at this pin: ConstantInfo.value? returns none for theorems unless called with (allowOpaque := true); a dependency scan that forgets it silently misses every theorem body.

In ×ˢ membership proofs, give the point explicitly (show ((a, b) : X × Y) ∈ s ×ˢ t from ⟨_, _⟩): the anonymous constructor otherwise unifies the point with an unrelated pair whose first component matches.

notes.for_the_master (graduation): Seven new modules under scaffold/CausalScaffold/GluingModels/, none imported by scaffold/CausalScaffold.lean (not mine to edit): add them to the scaffold root so the axiom sweep sees them (kb/0025). ModelScaffold imports CausalScaffold.GerochCauchy (which has a tagged sorry elsewhere in its file; ModelScaffold's own declarations use none) and must stay in the scaffold until GerochCauchy graduates; the six others import only Causal.* and each other (Minimal, NonMinimal, Pushout, ModelStatic, ModelSingular import Tools; ModelSingular imports Pushout). Every name lives in namespace Causal.GluingModels, so no collision with the strict library or the sibling. The four Lean scripts in campaign/T-abs-gluing-models/ (enumerate, uses, axioms, locate) are tools of this report, not library modules; gen_report.py rebuilds REPORT.json from their outputs. No build rebuilt a Causal.* or mathlib module (checked olean timestamps).
for_T-abs-gluing-design: Form of the field (OQ-95): among the 75 inventoried objects only the transparent-point line separates the hereditary form from the form on M. Every other object that glues on M glues hereditarily, and for the E≥0-manifolds the two coincide by a theorem (Causal.GluingModels.eManifold_hereditary_of_minimal: on M ⇒ hereditary through SFALocal.causallyArcConnected).

Proof to supply at the field switch, per construction site: for most glued objects the hereditary proof is one line from causal arc-connectedness; the exceptions with hand proofs are cutLine (not arc-connected), rationalLine and rationalJumpPlane (existing, rational subdivision), veeCausality, sierpinskiCausality, diagonalCausality, pointSpace, galileo 0, spokesCausality (copy of the library proof with the cover of W), branchingCausality (via the pushout lemma).

Definitions that need a hypothesis to glue: arcCausality γ glues for continuous arcs only (Causal.GluingModels.arcCausality_jumpArc_not_minimal refutes a discontinuous one), so at the field switch the def needs (hγ : ∀ i, Continuous (γ i)) or the field proof does; spokesCausality A glues for A a cone (A arbitrary not treated); linearCausality X depends on the topology of X (ℝ glues, ℕ and ℚ do not: linearCausality_nat_not_minimal, Causal.rat_not_absolutelyMinimal); chartedCausality D M needs D hereditary (existing hA); withoutChronology C and reflChrono C glue when C does; topEnlarge C and topTotal D never glue on a T1 space once they enlarge (topEnlarge_not_absolutelyMinimal, topTotal_not_absolutelyMinimal), and Causality.ofRelation never glues on a T2.5 space once its relation relates two distinct points (ofRelation_not_absolutelyMinimal).

Objects that stop being causalities under DEC-167 (OQ-96), with the ETT rows whose Lean witnesses they are (direct use by a ledger declaration): gateLine (no row; 7 ladder entries); jumpLine (7 ladder); globalLine (2 ladder); deuxPushup (rem:deux_pushup; 4 ladder); timelikeLineTop (ex:open_subset, prop:GX_espace_temps_topo), topEnlarge (prop:GX_espace_temps_topo, Causal.GX_maximal_not_unique) and topTotal (rem:btz_pas_tarentin, Causal.SFALocalE0.e0_topTotal_separates); transparentLine under the hereditary form only (cexemple:point_transparent); galileo n ≥ 1 (rem:galileo_spacetime_not_strongly; 1 ladder); and, newly found here: pointedLine (rem:K_neq_I: bubble_need_not_meet_Kplus, pointedLine_Kplus_zero; 1 ladder), pointedLineMR (rem:mesure_unilaterale_ptr: pointedLineMR_obstruction_hypotheses and two more), puncturedPlane (rem:K_plongement_hypotheses: hypothesis_a_needed), orderLine (defi:fonction_temps: IsTimeFunctionOrder, orderLine_id_not_isTimeFunction), bowtie and fan (rem:causal_completeness_slightly_weaker: both separating witnesses), linearCausality ℚ (def:causally_complete, def:causally_connected: the rat_* witnesses), allRelated (lem:past_BTZ: LineDevelopment.circle_line), sourceLine and radialLine (cexemple:misner_tarentin), the four DensWitness causalities (prop:Cauchy_pgcd: its refutation witnesses, already disclosed as non-local), doubledLine and totalLine (no ledger row names them directly).

On a discrete space an absolutely minimal ≤ is the diagonal (AbsolutelyMinimalOn.eq_of_discrete), so under DEC-167 no discrete witness can separate causal compactness from causal completeness: rem:causal_completeness_slightly_weaker needs non-discrete witnesses (the bowtie and the fan are both discrete).

The ETT rows whose witnesses survive (absolutely minimal, hereditarily): ex:causalities_lines items 1-3 and Minkowski space, rem:K_neq_I's halfChronoLine and spokes witnesses, rem:K_plongement_hypotheses's spacelikeLine, lem:cup_cap_BTZ's natCausality, rem:K_borelien's spokes, every model row (static, massive, cosmic string, flat, E₀, E≥0 family, singular flat axioms).
